verificationNotes: HTTP files that dispose the cached HttpApiApp.webHandler run in separate processes; combining them reuses a closed fixture.
Browser HTTP/WebSocket fixtures validate UI interaction and failure handling, not upstream provider authorization or packaged Electron behavior.
Focused mutation probes rejected the specific broken behaviors; passing checks do not establish whole-product perfection.
Recorded large-catalog tests verify bounded rows; session benchmark comparisons have shared-host variance and do not establish causal speedups.
explicitLimits: CI was not run or published in this task.
No live model turns using owner credentials were performed.
Packaged desktop behavior on Windows/Linux and real screen-reader coverage remain unverified.
V2 session subagent-model permission updates lack a public endpoint; UI shows unsupported capability instead of silently pretending to save.
V2 archive lacks a compatible endpoint; unsupported actions are disabled with explanatory copy.
